title: Frontage
description: What stands along a district's block faces (M2.1): the city has fixed each lot's frontage, and this picks a building for each by weight among those that fit, or leaves it empty.

street.description: The sidewalk, curb and roadway in front.

fill.description: Buildings by weight, among those whose narrowest fits the lot.

vacant.description: An empty lot, by weight beside the fill.

gap.description: Least room left beside a building on its lot: a gangway, in metres.
